findings.ref: DoD-4, AS-11a, AC-M7-09, EFF-10, SEC-07, T1
findings.problem: Key SQL conditions are not covered by any mutation check, and 8 one-line mutations survive the whole suite: _SQL_OWN tenant filter removed (cross-tenant read through effects.status when the same principal ID is registered in two tenants: the schema allows ^(agent|oidc):\S+$); gxg_cancel tenant filter removed; gxg_decide 'oidc:' guard removed (an agent that is not the requester can approve); gxg_dispatch intent/sub check removed; insert guard status<->mode removed; auto-decision mode guard removed; received_approvals counts policy decisions. Every cross-tenant test also changes the principal.
findings.reproduction: replace 'tenant_id = %s' in _SQL_OWN with '(tenant_id = %s OR true)' -> uv run pytest approval/tests approval/tests_db: 363 passed
findings.required_improvement: tests that kill all 8 (same principal ID in t-alpha and t-beta for GET and cancel with byte-identical 404; agent approver != requester -> permission_denied; token sub of another intent -> not_found; insert-guard rows; received_approvals of an auto intent = 0); a committed SQL mutation check (list of one-line mutations of the key SQL conditions run against tests_db, results in reports/mutmut/M7.txt) because no mature PL/pgSQL mutation tool exists; api.py and mcp.py in [tool.mutmut] only_mutate; delete or justify the unreachable live-execution check in gxg_cancel
